C_COD_CREDITED_DEFECTS.rationale: Both credited defects are reported with the triggering inputs: missing/unhandled account tiers (such as "Standard", a new tier, or None) triggering KeyError, and empty coupon_codes triggering IndexError.

C_COD_FURTHER_PROBLEMS.rationale: The candidate identifies multiple real surplus issues with explanations of why they matter, notably the use of binary floating-point arithmetic for currency without an explicit rounding rule causing reconciliation drift, as well as only using the first coupon code in the list.

C_COD_WHO_IS_AFFECTED.rationale: The candidate clearly identifies that the merchant loses revenue (is unpaid), tracks who ends up out of pocket, and highlights that Calls 1 and 2 succeed silently with wrong amounts while noting that negative numbers cause downstream ledger/payment rejections.
